name: @psyb0t/audiolla
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted audiolla audio-production API over MCP — stem separation, mastering, MIR analysis, DSP, restoration, and MIDI as tools.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running audiolla instance's MCP endpoint (/v1/mcp), exposing its tool surface: Demucs/MDX/BS-Roformer stem separation, matchering/pedalboard mastering, librosa MIR analysis (BPM/key/LUFS/beats/onsets/melody/segments), SoX and pedalboard DSP chains, multiband compression, transient shaping, sidechain ducking, de-essing, AI restoration (de-reverb/de-echo/de-noise via UVR), DeepFilterNet enhancement, VAD, speaker diarization, MIDI compose/inspect/transform/render/humanize, audio-to-MIDI transcription, tagging/embedding/classification, metadata read/write, curated workflow presets, ad-hoc op pipelines, and text-to-music/SFX generation. audiolla is self-hosted — you run the server yourself and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-audiolla.

AUDIOLLA_URL.description: Base URL of your running audiolla server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /v1/mcp).

AUDIOLLA_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token, only if the audiolla server was started with AUDIOLLA_AUTH_TOKEN set.
